mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a 20-day return predictor falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns in FEDFUNDS < 1.0% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of UNRATE > 5.0% instances, or average returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month and moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2.5% annualized creates favorable demand conditions without inflationary pressure, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for combined RSAFS/CPIAUCSL condition falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns when condition is met are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand for housing, which precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day S&P 500 returns during late-cycle expansion with rising HOUST are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC for HOUST in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 0.5% month-over-month indicates strong corporate output capacity, supporting earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a 60-day return predictor falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 60-day returns in INDPRO growth > 0.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% annualized signals accelerating inflation that triggers central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% instances, or average returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS) above 0.3% month-over-month and consumer spending (RSAFS) growth exceeding 0.4% month-over-month indicate synchronized labor market strength and consumption expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for combined PAYEMS/RSAFS growth condition falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns when condition is met are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day S&P 500 returns during monetary tightening cycles with rising FEDFUNDS are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
